evidenceScope: Targets thirty restored calls across all twelve names and three compensation modes, both allocation roles, partial/full/zero obligations and saved refund openings after later draws. Each transaction uses its saved synthetic execution time and separate Rust verification before strict synthetic ledger replay. Actual completion is established by traces/complete only; no fee balancing, finalized network, actual receipt/payout, independent administration or full-history privacy claim.
fingerprintScope: Runtime hashes identify exact files executed; LF-normalized hashes correlate Git source and do not establish another run.
